name: bp-detector
description: Fires five statistical alert rules over a window of enriched mentions: spike, crisis, review_bomb, influencer_mention and competitor_move. Every alert carries the observed value and the threshold that fired it. No language model is involved.

skills.name: Detect alerts
skills.description: Takes a DetectInput of enriched mentions plus 14-day baseline statistics and returns an AlertSet. Deterministic: the same input always produces the same alerts and the same dedupe keys.
examples: Detect alerts for brand brd_01J9 over the last 24 hours against its 14-day baseline.
Check whether the current hour's Twitter volume and negative share cross the crisis thresholds.
